SRC-086:R001.text: Do not rewrite or merge historical source receipts.

SRC-086:R002.text: Do not invent a dependency on T-236 merely because this feature can reuse code implemented during T-236.

SRC-086:R003.text: Do not make the operator complete T-236 browser acceptance before beginning this feature.

SRC-086:R004.text: The operator must not need to:

SRC-086:R005.text: Do not hard-code a universal assumption that every provider has exactly one 5-hour limit.

SRC-086:R006.text: Routine limit observation must not waste model quota.

SRC-086:R007.text: Never accidentally consume quota merely to check whether quota exists.

SRC-086:R008.text: A trigger must never turn into two agents, two prompts, or two audits because the UI restarted or two processes observed the same due time.

SRC-086:R010.text: But a stale optional limit source must not brick unrelated launchers or unrelated prepared jobs.

SRC-086:R011.text: The operator must always be able to see:

SRC-086:R012.text: Do not treat launcher ids as the final account model.

SRC-086:R013.text: Account identity must remain stable across application restarts.

SRC-086:R014.text: Do not use display name alone as identity.

SRC-086:R015.text: Do not include credentials in account ids.

SRC-086:R017.text: Do not hash secrets merely to use the hash as identity.

SRC-086:R018.text: Do NOT recursively scan the whole user profile or disks.

SRC-086:R021.text: Do not store full auth files.

SRC-086:R023.text: Do not silently guess between multiple plausible launchers.

SRC-086:R024.text: Do not scatter provider-specific quota parsing through Qt widgets or launch code.

SRC-086:R025.text: Never invent percentages from incomplete information.

SRC-086:R026.text: Availability must consider all relevant hard windows.

SRC-086:R027.text: Detailed tooltip must display all known windows.

SRC-086:R028.text: Do not use model prompts as normal polling.

SRC-086:R029.text: Do not modify the other applications state.

SRC-086:R030.text: Do not create a hard dependency.

SRC-086:R031.text: Do not scrape screenshots or UI pixels.

SRC-086:R032.text: do not probe more frequently merely because a timer exists.

SRC-086:R033.text: Do not run a minute-by-minute network poll for hours.

SRC-086:R034.text: Do not permanently switch the account to one-minute polling.

SRC-086:R035.text: Repeated probe errors must back off.

SRC-086:R036.text: One provider failure must not stop other account probes.

SRC-086:R037.text: Do not copy UI code blindly.

SRC-086:R038.text: Do not make project rows dramatically taller.

SRC-086:R039.text: Do not turn ten launcher buttons into unreadable Christmas lights.

SRC-086:R040.text: ERROR must not look identical to exhausted quota.

SRC-086:R041.text: Do not expose tokens or credential paths unnecessarily.

SRC-086:R042.text: Do not overload Settings with all runtime scheduling state.

SRC-086:R043.text: A prepared launch must be a real persistent scheduled entity.

SRC-086:R044.text: Do not store runtime state only in Qt widgets.

SRC-086:R045.text: Do not simply choose the newest .md in the folder.

SRC-086:R047.text: Do not mutate the captured original.

SRC-086:R048.text: Do not log the entire command in general diagnostic logs.

SRC-086:R049.text: Do not create a second audit dispatch implementation.

SRC-086:R050.text: Do not blindly pass Claude flags to Codex or Codex flags to ZCode.

SRC-086:R051.text: Do not depend forever on parsing --help on every launch.

SRC-086:R052.text: Do not hard-code a supposedly permanent model catalog.

SRC-086:R053.text: Do not guess arguments from internet memory.

SRC-086:R054.text: Prepared scheduling must not duplicate launcher implementation.

SRC-086:R055.text: must go through the same authoritative launcher logic for:

SRC-086:R057.text: After launch, prepared content must enter the agent reliably.

SRC-086:R058.text: Do NOT default to fragile keyboard simulation or SendKeys.

SRC-086:R059.text: Do not pretend a launched empty terminal executed the prepared work.

SRC-086:R060.text: A reset event must have a stable identity.

SRC-086:R061.text: A recurring ON RESET job must execute at most once for one reset event.

SRC-086:R062.text: A process restart at reset+30s must not create a second execution.

SRC-086:R063.text: Do not keep firing against the obsolete time.

SRC-086:R064.text: Do not store only a locale-formatted string.

SRC-086:R067.text: The scheduler must know whether synchronization by first use is meaningful.

SRC-086:R068.text: Do not tell the user two accounts were synchronized when the provider uses a fixed independent schedule.

SRC-086:R070.text: do not lie about successful synchronization.

SRC-086:R073.text: Do not assume using a "cheap model" starts the same 5h timer as the expensive model.

SRC-086:R074.text: Do not burn usage experimentally without explicit operator action.

SRC-086:R076.text: Do not invent exact command flags.

SRC-086:R077.text: Do not optimize cost by starting the wrong timer.

SRC-086:R078.text: It must never repeat merely because AUDAPACK restarted.

SRC-086:R080.text: Do not infer scheduling state only from timestamps.

SRC-086:R082.text: Do not depend on a Qt widget timer as the sole authority.

SRC-086:R083.text: Do not create two independent schedulers in GUI and Bridge.

SRC-086:R084.text: Do not write runtime state into repository source files.

SRC-086:R085.text: Do not place provider auth tokens into scheduler JSON.

SRC-086:R087.text: Do not present inferred time with the same confidence as provider-supplied time.

SRC-086:R088.text: Do not build one giant form containing every option simultaneously.

SRC-086:R090.text: It must create a normal execution receipt.

SRC-086:R092.text: Prepared scheduling must build a project-aware handoff index.

SRC-086:R093.text: Never select a handoff only because its filename happens to sort last.
